profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta (Facebook)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead responsible for delivering our in-house IDE suite of products and our code authoring experience

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Windows Kernel Team
positions.description: As an OS kernel developer, I worked on a variety of different projects within Windows Operating Systems Group across several releases including OS performance improvements, adding OS and kernel level support for Solid State Hybrid Hard Drives, and improving battery life impact of background activity within the Windows Universal App Platform by over 40%. I also contributed to Project Astoria (platform bridge for running Android apps on Windows) and the Linux Subsystem for Windows.

positions.title: President, Owner
positions.description: President and owner of Blue Building, Inc. I founded Blue Building in 2002 to provide web design and hosting services to a variety of small businesses, law firms and non-profit organizations in the Western New York area. I designed, built and maintained websites ranging from simple static web presences to complex custom CGI and database-driven web applications that automated business-critical workflows and incorporated custom e-commerce solutions.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Summer internship as a Software Development Engineer intern for the Microsoft Windows Core Deployment team. My summer project focused on solving problems relating to cross-version and cross-architecture servicing of offline Windows OS images including adding and configuring OS-level components and packages, adding drivers to an offline OS image and other operations typically performed by OEMs, Enthusiasts and PC builders.

positions.title: Web/Systems Programmer
positions.description:
Worked on various web programming projects, primarily in ColdFusion creating modules to augment an existing Content Management System which is licensed to companies in the Food Service industry.

Researched technical issues, located or wrote software patches in Java, C and ColdFusion as needed.

patents.title: Achieving a consistent computing device battery drain rate
patents.description: Achieving a consistent battery drain rate at a computing device includes identifying an amount of available battery energy, and identifying a target device runtime using the available energy. A plurality of time periods over which to budget energy use to achieve the target device runtime are identified, and an allotment of the available energy for each of the plurality of time periods is determined. A determination of how to allocate the allotted energy for a current time period is made. The determination includes identifying a priority of each application based user-facing attributes of each application, identifying an energy budget for each application, and allocating a portion of the allotted energy for the current time period to each application based on their identified priority and their energy budget. The energy budget for at least one application is adjusted based on that applications' energy usage during the current time period.

patents.title: Reducing system energy consumption through event trigger coalescing
patents.description: Coalescing triggers from external events. Embodiments include receiving a plurality of triggers, each associated with occurrence of an external event. A first trigger identified as time critical is scheduled for firing. A second trigger identified as opportunistic is coalesced with others of the plurality of triggers. Coalescing includes determining an importance of an application-based workload associated with the second trigger, determining a system state relevant to firing the second trigger, and determining a condition for firing the second trigger based on the importance of the workload and the system state. Coalescing also includes identifying that the condition for firing the second trigger aligns with a condition for firing the others of the plurality of triggers, and scheduling the second trigger for firing along with the others of the plurality of triggers. Embodiments also include subsequently firing the second trigger along with the others of the plurality of triggers.
